Final categorization: EXCLUDED

Justification: This paper is an original research article focusing on quantifying greenhouse gas emissions and mitigation potentials in agriculture and land use sectors in Bangladesh using a bottom-up model. Although it involves land use change emissions, the primary focus is on climate change mitigation potential and cost-effectiveness of technologies rather than on land use/land cover (LULC) future prediction or simulation. The study does not perform spatially explicit LULC modeling or generate mapped LULC projections, nor does it evaluate multiple future LULC scenarios with quantitative spatial accuracy metrics. The land use change component is modeled in terms of aggregated emissions and mitigation potentials at the national level without spatially explicit LULC outputs. Therefore, it does not meet core inclusion criteria related to LULC prediction and spatial modeling. It also does not qualify as a review article. Hence, it is excluded based on the core criteria.
